MS 12. 1 – pp. 14-158

MS 12. 2 – pp. 1-36

The year 1892 opens with a day of much interior consolation. Mother Rosa in spite of her sixty years, well troubled, is in full shape. On January 19 she wrote: “I feel strong in spirit and in body, nothing frightens me.” She experienced a complete detachment from earthly things. She accepted being alone in the face of her responsibilities because God wanted it, living as “in a foreign land walking and fighting with strangers.”

Parallel to the Memorie she also wrote the “fantasies” of the book Travagli e Conforti.

Her habit of depending on the will of God made her so resigned, and indifferent that it seemed to her that by now she was insensitive to sufferings; nothing gave her pleasure on this earth, while the experience of union with God became more delighting and transforming. In spite of this on May 19 she wrote: “The pains are my daily food.”

At the end of May she experienced deep delusion regarding the Protector Cardinal in whom she had placed much hope. It was an atrocious suffering: she lost her trust in him but after she regained it. In fact the same Cardinal Verga will obtain the definitive approval of the Constitutions presented by himself on 26 July, feast of St. Anne. It was a day of immense joy for the Foundress. In the month of September again the relationship with the Cardinal will become difficult because of the jealousy of a sister.

On November 19 she made a realistic reflection of her physical limitations: “Now, because of age I have some strange weaknesses.” In the same month during the Spiritual Exercise she is unable to dominate her disappointment on the theme presented by the preacher who blurs the consciences. It is that “ill-mannered shepherd” of whom she mentioned in Travagli e Conforti: “He did not know anything other than speak on justice.”

MS 12. 1 – pp. 14 – 158

A strong union with God in Holy Communion

1st January 1892. This morning after Holy Communion, the union with God was so strong that my side was raised and my bones… // The fire was something! When the Protector Verga reached the moment of elevation even he took more time than usual… I do not know how to express it; I will say that I felt and tasted something of heaven.

I remained in that state until the end of the gospel.

Oh, my Love, how short was that time! Again I am in my miserable state.

I would have never believed to have so much consolation after having spent a night with many visits, so black and big that I was unable to sleep // at all and I was upset until the waking hour, when I suffered much… It was true that the earlier day I was forestalled; I doubted much because the preparation was very bad.

Vision of a weeping sister

3 January 1892. This evening while I was kneeling on the ground and resting in my God because I was very tired, I recalled a point of his passion and meditated. I do not know how a voice whispered to me saying // that a sister was weeping much, but I did not care at all. At a certain moment I saw a sister but I saw only the face. I asked who she was; I thought she was one and then another, but who was she? A light as that of fire appeared in the midst of her fore-front and I saw her better. That light attracted my attention fully; it was so beautiful; in that instant I would have said she was my Sister Anne del Salvatore. I was able to understand nothing, but I remained serene. // I wanted to be able to discover the meaning of the light which until now is before me; I cannot say it is an illusion, no, because

I saw her clearly with open eyes for two good minutes as she stood before me. What will be? Certainly I will not delay to have the explanation.

I do not know what it is; in these days I feel repugnance for everything that is presented to me of which I must be occupied. I must // struggle and I can never speak of being overcome, but I must also confess to being continually in battle; I feel much suffering.

“I feel strong in spirit and body; nothing frightens me”

19 January 1892. This night at half past two, something which I cannot explain came upon me. I woke up and I was so united with my God that my side was very… The ribs were raised and I was unable to avoid crying: - I am dying!

It was long since it happened. While I said I was dying it was // very sweet! Oh, how I remained with my God!

Who can describe it? I would feel nothing if I would really die, but this death is very consoling. I feel strong in spirit and in body; nothing frightens me.

I meditated and that was how I spent the night, I mean after half past two. My Love!

I was unable to write in the past days about all the people who came to meet me. Bishops who were Cardinals but since they came with the miter // I could not distinguish them. In the same way there were skulls of dead people, skeletons and sisters but these with the small and big stars.

The news that I received on the dark souls are verified in details; these give me much pain.

Strong affliction at the news that some people entered her room of Piacenza

24 January 1892. How much I suffered in these days, I am unable to describe. What a terrible trial because of the persecution of a woman whom the devil had incited to such an extent that it put in her mind to obtain from the court to come // to confiscate. And how?

In my poorest room,1 where for twenty-five good years nobody entered! Only once a person entered who saw nothing.

Therefore it can be said that a human creature never saw what was in it. Oh, how I still feel lively pain!

Oh, my Love, I hoped that never would you allow anyone to come to know of my life of penance before I died!

I always deluded the world // and it never knew, but now they might have seen my crosses; the one on which I climbed and the other one which I used as a bed. I wish to be sure that they were frightened and went back soon because they felt a dread; this makes me hope that it has been like that because my Crucifix would not allow them to understand and to see.

On the other hand, except the one which hung on the wall they were not able to see, but this seems to me already enough. Oh, if they could have discovered the discipline which is wrapped? // Oh, I would feel bad and the same would be for all the remaining!

Patience, my Love! What a hard trial this has been for me! I would have never thought of suffering so much.

On the same evening in which I received this news I was unable to find peace and I always said to my Good:

Oh, my sweet Love, you did something too much to me!

After I asked him the reason and I asked // that he may accept my suffering and he may settle such quarrels. Tired

I turned to my dear Crucifix saying:

  • My Love!

Having said this I remained absorbed and with the mind

I seemed to be tightly holding his neck, I meditated on the pains he suffered in the crowning of thorns and the blood that poured, all the torture of the wounds so lively that I do not know if in reality I was with my God or only in the union // I saw and felt this.

How much I stayed in this state! I would have liked it to continue always.

Interior unrest motivated by the night apparitions

25 January 1892. How much I suffered last night!

At half past eleven, I felt faint and I stayed a long time in this manner. When recovered I spent more than one hour. When I woke up it seemed to me as if I was to suffer again but I slept. At half past three I woke up as if I was // called.

My God, what was it? I saw the bust of a dead creature;

it was white as if made of a marble placed on a chair at the back of the bed.

On the head it had something like a veil a bit hanging raised and crumpled. I looked at it, for fear of recognizing the person I turned on the other side hoping that it would go away. Not at all! After some time I turned and it was there. I was very upset. I would have liked to know the person but then I regretted // and I did not want to look at it.

How long it stayed and what pain it left me! I never thought of asking who it was because I was very upset and I was unable to sleep. It is a real martyrdom when these people come and say nothing.

What a sad day I spent this day and now as I write it is late at night. I am not able to sleep because I feel much interior unrest and // I do not understand where it came from.

Presage of an epidemic

1st February 1892. This happened on 29 January. At three after midnight I woke up as if I was shaken. My God, what a sight! Near the window high on the wall there were terrible signs: two big signs of blood as if they were two united hearts. But they were not hearts at all but thick blood that was a dread. All around there were long stripes and there were also short ones with knots and they ended with a point. They remained at length. // At the first impression I said:

  • A horrible epidemic!

Meanwhile looking at it I was persuaded that it must be an epidemic. What will it be, my God?

Sleep disappeared completely. I looked with my open eyes and I saw others. I signed myself and after a long time I turned to the other side, to the left. I saw the same sign not to the south but on the east without the blood and I became more convinced that it was an epidemic; // but I heard nothing.

What a pain this is for me! In these days the tribulations are many and so intimate that they bend me.

My Love, how painful this state is!

Fire of Love for the whole day

4 February 1892. On the second, feast of the presentation in the temple, after Holy Communion when the Protector Cardinal Verga reached the consecration in his Mass, my God, the side started to be united to its God…

My ribs were raised and the action was so violent that I was not able to stand. I said:

  • My Love, I cannot bear it anymore! I am dying, I cry,

I fear crying!

But for God’s mercy I was able to stop. //

I resisted until the consummation; what I felt! I remained worn out. This continued until the afternoon: the extremities were cool and I had a trembling that I thought

I had fever. But it was my side that left me like this and the ribs were as of wax. Finally today I feel a bit better.

Total detachment from earthly things

8 February 1892. Last night, at half past three after midnight, I was shaken and I woke up. My God, what a big beast was there! //

It had very long legs all around the body. Big and small, with knots; it resembled very much the big sign of blood and long signs with knots. I do not understand if it is war instead of an epidemic. I can understand nothing, because I did not have even a word from that one of last night. It was a usual beast, but it was very long. It was two meters above my head and from the way it fell // it left me much fear and a deep melancholy. Certainly there must be very painful things.

Patience!

This monster never finishes and I feel that with your help, my God, I should take everything in peace and resignation.

The detachment from the things of the earth is such that I am assured of feeling nothing anymore. Only this miserable humanity feels the burden but the consolation that I feel in my heart is much. // I feel more desire to suffer.

My Love, to suffer for you is sweet, Being of my life!

To live in a foreign land, walking and fighting with strangers

14 February 1892. For some days now my sleep has been interrupted by those black so fearful animals that try to hide whatever they do; but by now I understand well the meaning. It is clear that for them to come here to inform me of their misdeeds is damnation. As soon as they realize that I understand what do they do? They disappear. // It is true that they leave me a negative impression and I suffer much.

My most sweet Jesus has well provided for his Work in the person of His most Eminence Verga. I repeated he is a true relief for me and he really gives me life; he is a support, a strong arm. May God reward him! Oh, if the same could be also for my poor spirit!

Enough. I am alone, my Love, and I feel // much deprivation of a guide in these moments in which you are hidden. Patience! If this is your will let it be done in everything and I will be happy in the very hard sufferings because I have not a drop of relief. The only comfort is the thought that it is your will that keeps me in this foreign land, makes me journey and battle with strangers. I force myself to understand them and when // I think that it is an exile that has no duration, I am comforted.

Ghosts in dresses of Cardinal

21 February 1892. After suffering much, today I felt the bed and I would like to describe everything I had of torture. I had such a painful agony that I did not know if in certain moments I lived or I was breathing my last or I was already dead, because I had lost my senses.

Friday night, I do not remember the hour because I slept. A shaking woke me and it was a red beast, // the color of the dress of a Cardinal and it played the peacock a meter over my bed.

It might have had a thousand legs, a small body and legs all around: big, small and short. The ones might have reached twenty centimeters, the short half of this. It rose slowly to the ceiling and vanished. My impression was that it might be a sign of blood but it did not leave me much fear; instead I felt like laughing for the way in which it showed off and did certain gestures. // If it was war or an epidemic I could have been terrified, but not. I heard a diabolic voice:

  • How beautiful, isn’t it?

  • How could it be, ugly monster, you have the courage to say you are beautiful? You are filthy!

Within me I felt laughter, since I was in company; I tried not to let them realize it.

How odd the one which came very close to me, perhaps eighty centimeters high from my face, was dressed as a Cardinal. How I laughed! I was unable to stop. It played a peacock and tried to frighten me. //

My God, what have I done; why does this beast persecute me?

  • Enough snout – I said laughing – leave aside the princes of the holy Church for they are oppressed enough!

Certainly this ugly monster may have whispered and I will know it soon.

6 March 1892. Unfortunately I knew who the Cardinal was. I had to prepare a report which I did as we deserved and this is how I had much affliction.

This morning after my thanksgiving I saw a head with a white miter that was // before me and it caused me much pain. On the sides white hairs were visible. How it upset me! Who could it be? I heard nothing and I was unable to understand.

The beasts continue to pass and some cause me pain.

Suffering without relief.

Cardinal Verga, true father of the Institute

25 March 1892. In the past nights I had horrible monsters in the room. A big beast left me such an illness that it seemed to me I had been scourged. My God, I always feel this impression when a Daughter of St. Anne // fails in something grave. Oh, how much pain I feel and I am always informed in this manner! Even the others caused me much pain. My pains are so strong that many times I feel faint without having any relief. With whom should I share these pains? I remain closed in myself under this painful martyrdom.

During the day while I was reasoning but I do not know with whom, it seemed to me // that a voice had concluded telling me loudly:

  • For twenty days there will be a good time.

Oh, Jesus, if this could be attributed to my soul! If I could be lifted up and have some kind of comfort and peace for twenty days and if the tribulations could be reduced!

But this does not seem to be happening because in my poor spirit I am suffering a lot and certainly since I see that the sun is shining, I understand it is attributed to this. //

In the past days not even the sun has been beautiful; what will happen? An interior voice said to me that there will be a respite to the terrible tribulations and I had to confess this to be true.

My God what will come to me? I feel fear. May your divine will be done in everything.

The Protector Cardinal Verga continued to be someone great for the poor Institute. Oh, what a father! His charity has no equal: a man of God, of much purity of intention, so clear in his actions and words, sincere in // an extraordinary manner. How much relief I find! For 26 years that the Institute existed I never had an equal Protector. For it is a great relief in the affairs of the Work: he smoothes everything and takes everything upon himself. Oh, my God, pour upon him the choicest blessings!

“I promised to restart writing my fantasies”

2 April 1892. Feast of St. Francis of Paola, I received Holy Communion for his glory and I was rewarded widely by the saint. As soon as I received, I was very united with my Love. //

This morning it seemed clear to me I had received a grace for which I asked God for a long time and I felt much sweetness. I did not know how to thank the saint, and more so I was upset for some days. Within me I felt a grief which gave me much pain. Oh, mercy of my God towards this poor slave!

I made many promises especially that of restarting to write those fantasies2 – that is what I call them – but it seems that my Master desires it // and from this evening I will start doing it.

Gratitude towards divine Providence

11 April 1892. This morning before coming out of the church I asked God for providence and I wondered how I could pay a sum on the 22nd of the month.

I went where I kept the money knowing there was not enough to pay such amount. Oh, surprise: as I opened the drawer I found the money doubled // more than what I needed.

Throwing myself at the foot of the altar I thanked with all my strength the Eternal Father and my sweet Jesus. Oh, my Love, how much charity and mercy!

I had to force myself not to be noticed for the consolation that I always felt.

Oh, my Love, when I think I feel much joy and I always feel // to be nothing and less than nothing! Only you live in me…

What days of pain and suffering to see much ingratitude towards God on the side of many creatures so much benefited who have a place in the Work of the Lord!

However, the past is never remembered; who were we?

To be brides of the Lord and to be called as such!

Oh, my Love, poor me, I am worse than all! //

“I feel so resigned that I even fear becoming insensitive to suffering”

Good Friday 1892. What I suffered I cannot describe; the pains at the breast, on the arms, on the hands and on the feet were torturing. But those which made me faint were the pains in the legs which were coming off the loins and they assailed me so fiercely that they took away the knowledge. My head was united because all the nerves came off. The pains in the breast were as if the ribs came out one from the other and even today I feel the pain // as a bruise; in speaking I feel pain and it is horrible.

Oh, my Love, what might have been yours in comparison to what I feel!

I stayed at length with my Good; I had much beautiful knowledge on certain affairs of the Institute and of my spirit; peace and resignation in the new tribulations of this period. Some people who have been benefited try to give me every kind of pain; but I feel so // calm and resigned that I even fear becoming insensitive to any kind of pain. As soon as I receive tribulations it is sweet to say:

  • My Love, I offer you this, accept it; it is much for me and it wounds me bitterly but it pleases you. Oh, I am happy to be able to suffer, to please your Majesty, my Good, Being of my life. I am happy in carrying out your divine will.

I was always united with my Good in those sufferings of Friday; // I needed nothing. Only love sustained me and gave me life.

“Nothing gives me the minimum pleasure.

I am indifferent towards all the creatures”

18 April 1892. I am much tormented by the demons and by the interior tribulations; I feel so afflicted that I do not know how to express so much anxiety. My God has completely abandoned me; I do not find peace, I do not know where to lean my head to rest it. Oh, how it travels in the dark, in the midst of mountains and arid forests!

Poor me, // what a tribulation is this! Wherever I turn my eyes what I see grieves me; I feel something within me that seems to tell me:

  • This is not for you.

I feel nothing gives me the least pleasure; everything has the effect of things that as soon as they are seen they vanish.

In the past I was pleased when I saw something that smiled at me; I desired to posses. Now nothing, I am // indifferent towards all creatures.

I feared much that my superiors might have something special for me and I felt that I would be pleased; something that I never had. Perhaps for this reason I am indifferent now; if they protect me or not, it is the same; it brings me nothing. I judge on this thing from much suffering that I had for which I acquired indifference, and I feel // that it is very beautiful and great to possess it.

If I look at the past, I feel shivering for what I passed through always contradicted and held as a rusty iron good to be rubbed.

I understand that I would have never reached this point if I would not have been beaten by a strong and very strict hand.

I bless the one who has beaten me and God who in his great mercy allowed him. //

This work is extremely horrible because it consumes and destroys; only the omnipotent hand of God can give strength to be able to bear such torturing suffering. I do not know how it could be borne.

The experience of the union with God is ineffable

Today I was so much battled by fear for having done a bad action; although it was charitable how painful it was!

Soon I asked my God to give me a proof for pity’s sake, // so that I may know if it still pleased him. He did not delay an instant; I had the material proof that my God was happy.

How I felt to be in peace! I am so happy when with facts I can be assured that what I do is fully pleasing to him. Oh, happiness without compare! I become ten years old because I forget the age and the infirmities; I remember nothing and I am so out of myself because of the // joy…

Oh, my Love, how happy I am in fulfilling your most holy will!

The joy that is felt is great when I am unable to express it! Every time my protector father comes to say Mass, a fire comes up on my side and when he reaches the elevation, his heart is clear, I see him to be very united with God. What I feel for such a sight! My side seems to be melting, so much is the fire // that consumes it. As this fire is communicated to me the union with my God becomes intimate.

How clearly is seen such a union, my God! How can I explain it if there is no comparison? Everything is experienced and in the experience everything is understood but one is unable to explain. They are such interwoven experiences that it is not possible to explain, even for the one who experiences it. // Only God could do it!

My sufferings are many and I feel a deep wound; I do not know how to force myself so that they may not realize.

“It is so painful my God, why so much torture? Yes, I merit everything because I serve you very badly!”

“Suffering is my daily bread”

19 May 1892. It is a long time since I was able to write what took place in me; I always have my usual strong impulse: write!

But the health // and the work… When I feel worn out, I feel I abandon myself with ease. Many times I have a bit of fear of being overcome and of failing; certainly in the past years I never cared but now, I do not know, something within me is stronger than reason. For some days I repeated that the arm pained me so much that the swelling did not allow me to move the hand and the swelling of the arm, // in placing it on the table, gave me spasmodic pains. One would not believe: as soon as I submitted this obstacle I was healed even if not completely; this according to the doctor is impossible, but I do not feel it anymore and I can write the whole day and I feel nothing.

I would like to leave aside writing always about the sufferings I feel, but how can I if these are my daily bread?

At night the devils always come into my room now in one

// and then in another way, such that with their signs they leave me upsetting pains as in the past nights. They tormented me showing me that if I do not receive certain graces the reason was because I do not work well and for this I am punished by my God.

I asked what I did not do well that I passionately desired to amend; if I could only imagine from where these failures come // I could soon remove them. But the liar tempter was not able to give me a reply and for this it pretended to leave the phrase suspended.

How much I suffered yesterday was torturing. I always felt faint and at every moment life was failing me. I felt this was as a result of great tribulation that was to come soon and that I would have felt it much. // My God! What a torture!

Now I wait for it and I prepare for it with resignation.

My God give me strength to be able to bear it.

I do not speak of the beasts which come to disturb me and show me ugly and bad news which would take place.

How much I suffer! But if this pleases my God I suffer with pleasure and desire that they may come quickly. The humanity certainly // rebels with much repugnance.

Painful delusion regarding the Protector.

“I closed myself completely”

27 May 1892. I am oppressed by such a deep melancholy that I have difficulty being careful not to be noticed by others.

Mostly it was because of having observed in the Protector something suspicious towards me for certain gossips that reached him. On the other hand I am serene because I never hide anything from him; // this certainly has nothing to do with me, but in truth I do tell him everything and then… may it all be for Jesus!

This is what you allow, my God; may your will be done to which I am always resigned! I adore your decrees which are very just against me because I am the most wretched creature of this world, but I love you much. However, in these cruel torments I feel // deep within me lively pain and anxiety. It is very painful, but in peace I will carry this atrocious suffering because in such a cruel state I have no relief, not even a word. You have abandoned me and you have thrown me into the cruelest aridity.

What anguishes, what agony is this that breaks the breast! If this is what you want, my Jesus, // may your will be done provided that I am not the cause of your abandonment. Oh, cruel exile, how torturing is to stay in it and if it is your will, I am ready to remain until the end of all the centuries.

Oh, what a painful martyrdom, I do not see the minimum escape! Everything is melancholy and pain. I would like to be able to describe how this humanity // suffers.

Certain beasts that come seem victorious for having finally found the way of oppressing me and act spitefully as much as they can, but this does not bother me much since all they do has no duration; soon the victory will be bright and they will // be overcome. Some of them come dressed ridiculously that though I suffer within me, I feel like laughing.

In these days even in the Protector who relieved me I see in his heart an impression he received from a priest or many priests. He tries to conceal but I clearly see the unrest and I feel pain, such that my // situation seems to be so sad that I feel something drew me away and I have completely closed myself. Oh, world!

Everything is disappointing even the hope of having help. This is how it is for me. It seems impossible that this miserable humanity flatters itself and seeks relief while for me the thought of being relieved by a human creature by now should be extinct.

May Jesus // have pity on me!

How sad and painful for me is this month dedicated to the Blessed Virgin! An abyss of troubles oppresses me;

everywhere I turn my sight I see nothing except sufferings and such deep melancholy that I desire to remain in the church or in the room when I have free time because only solitude relieves me.

My Jesus, when will this painful state come to an end? It seems that for me there is // nothing more. Oh, horrible pains!

Painful anxieties and apparitions

31st May 1892. Yesterday afternoon while I was in the church after a short time trying to concentrate, I realized something: I was not able to distinguish from where it came.

I thought of praying vocally as if I understood nothing. A light appeared to me and in the middle I saw a person // but only the bust. From the portrait and from the whole color, it was a priest, though I was able to distinguish very little. He looked fixed at me and then disappeared. In the same way signs of an epidemic appeared to me. I believe if not mistaken it will be cholera. It will not be of the worst but it will be very widespread. My Good, how many notices! And we are always worse! Oh, have pity on me! //

26 June 1892. I am always molested by a strong melancholy but for the mercy of God no one realized and with much struggle I can conceal, laughing and joking. Only when I am alone do I weep. Unfortunately I have lost my Good for my continuous iniquities, such that I believe that I am in absolute blindness which makes me find nothing in my examinations.

Therefore, // my God, will you leave me like this? Oh, a thousand pains but not this! What is the whole world and heaven without you my Good? How could I live in such a pain?

Every moment I repeat: pity my God, mercy, forgiveness, my Love!

Ghosts of every kind, horrible shakings especially at night, deaths of every kind; some ask for prayers, others look at me mute. This is how a soul came very // close to my bed kneeling; it was turned on one side and kept its face covered with a veil as ours while in the hand it had a small feather stick. It kept it up showing it to me; the hand and the small stick were black. I asked who it was but it did not give me a reply. I wanted to see the face but while I tried to unveil it, it disappeared. A strong thought and an interior voice suggested to me that // it was a sister who had left, Eletta. I prayed that God may forgive her if she was in a place that she could be saved.

Even today while I was leaning on the bedside seated on a chair, I saw a big initial letter on the wall near the Crucifix. It was a beautiful V, well done, with a nice interlacement. What would it mean? It left me some kind of fear. It might be Blessed Virgin // or the Protector? My God, what would it mean that he might be sick? My Salvatore, what will be of his health?

She assured me that he was very well and therefore could it mean an affliction will come in the Institute? I am so upset because I do not understand the reason; it seems to me there are good things for the Institute; let us hope…

I am so frightened that at everything I see even without // any sad meaning, I am upset and I remain very thoughtful. I do not understand why all these people appear. I do not understand the objective. Could it be for prayers? My God, this I do not believe because it seems my prayers are done badly and then, woe betide me, they would not be of help. But if God in his mercy allows it, they // may see my misery, be moved to compassion, and pray for me. I think all know how to pray better than I.

“I am oppressed by deep suffering:

I am abandoned by my Good”

27 June 1892. I am always oppressed by deep suffering thinking that I am abandoned by my Good; everything is closed; I ask and I knock but there is nothing. I plead to know why I find myself this way, but I do not find a reply.

I seem to be in a cave // without a beam of hope of coming out. There is no reason that can satisfy me and the conclusion is that I merited everything without understanding where and how I am reduced so horribly.

Yes, my weaknesses reduced me to this; I have no other relief except the mercy of God. The hope in this keeps me alive giving me strength to beat the cruel torture // at the thought that my God had abandoned me.

A sister healed miraculously from an illness of diabolic origin

28 June 1892. From midnight and the whole of the day what I suffered! They were new things: I was dying; I was feeling something burning in the whole body. It seemed to me that a hand penetrated the liver and tore it; the swelling was very much with horrible fidgets. The worst was that I was unable to pray. // I shed some tears unwillingly because of the suffering I felt and not because of the pain, no I felt the tears pouring without any desire of weeping at all. This illness I attributed entirely to having believed and even wanting to believe to in an illness that a sister had. // I wanted to persuade myself that it was God’s gift and sincerely I asked God that he may give me a proof: healing me from a big swelling that I had in the liver. Even if it would have returned, if it was his will that I carry it, I would have accepted it, but if it was true that what the sister had was his work, that he may free me. Oh, what a spectacle! I was swollen more // and the swelling and the pain was so horrible that I had fever. I must say that I did not want to heed the voice that when I visited the sister was telling me that it was a diabolic work; since I always fear, I wanted to have a proof that it was really strong. Now I had ordered and I will see if what I ordered // the devil to do will happen. I will soon write what will happen.

The poor sister suffered much. She lost much blood without being able to see me because I was sick but this morning she ran to me to tell me everything. Immediately, as I said above, I strongly ordered the enemy…

Some minutes ago I went to the sister // whom I found well and I asked to see the wound. Oh, what a surprise! It was as if she had nothing; she was so well healed only on the outside she had a little bit of blood as if dried up but outside the wound. It might certainly be that which bled last night until she wet the mattress. I put more crosses on the pain because it was very deep and with odd pain: it seemed to me as if the brain would come out of the ears. How much I suffered! It lasted more than an hour and // even now - and it is late - I am feeling it a bit. It upset me in such a way that I did not know how to free myself. Interiorly I laughed because the snout had made me pay.

Oh, how easily can the one who guides these souls be mistaken! If there was not my voice to say it and the proof I immediately wanted, certainly the poor sister would have suffered thinking that was the work of // God; instead it was the ugly monster. I desire it to confirm with it an action that is very much on my mind // and I desire to be assured with a fact.

Renewed trust in the Cardinal Protector

My God, it is ten o’clock in the evening and I have obtained what I asked for. It is confusion for me: I see such interlacement being formed in my mind that I distinguish nothing else but my nothingness. It is what I see of myself that makes me feel disheartened.

My God, are all the creatures like this, as you show me of myself? Do they also see // this much nothingness? A volume of stuff started to appear but because I did not want to enter into serious arguments I drove it away. I did this because when I enter into certain arguments I fear reaching certain points that my Jesus will leave me… and not being able to solve the problem I must suffer more from fear of disgusting in the least my God. In this way I have learned

// not to reason anymore and to remain always in my nothingness and less than nothingness preferring the peace with my Good; in him everything, away from him I want nothing and everything disgusts me.

How can I thank my God for so much grace that he put in the heart of the Protector Verga, much spirit for his Work and always making him grow in affection towards the dear

Institute. Oh, // how I feel a true consolation! He is the upright and zealous shepherd, your true servant, my God!

How he carries in his heart the growth of your Work in observance and in other things; he cares for nothing else except the good of your brides, my God! He wants them holy and he is the model of humility and modesty; he is an example of uprightness, justice and obedience. // Oh, how I would like to have the pen of St. Augustine in order to describe well who has the fortune of possessing your dear Institute, my sweet love! How much grace for this miserable creature! May infinite gratitude be given to you, my Love, and all your brides are obliged to thank you and seek to keep on.

Oh, if I knew how to pray well! Because I // would like everything to be for him, as these which I make though they are done badly. What a fear I always feel in the prayers, my God, because the thought that I do not know how to pray is painful! Only when I am absorbed in him I find peace and I am at peace because I am sure of resting in my God. Oh, how difficult to know how to pray well // with real concentration! For this I fear much knowing that I do not know how to pray. How beautiful to see the Protector at the foot of the altar concentrated in prayer in holy simplicity. What I feel towards that creature! It seems to me I see my Good who is pleased with that soul and soon I see myself very shapeless! Oh, as the groan of a dove he moves the heart of the Lord while the // pleading of a miserable person as I am…

Yes, my Love, when in your infinite mercy, you allow me to see clearly my nothingness, I can do nothing else except feel a torturing pain; but in my nothingness I feel your mercy and I am animated full of hope. I even feel sure to be able to embrace you and still to have what I ask of you, // my sweet Love!

“My Love only you and nothing else!”

2 July 1892. It was really a day of emotion. Always with my God I tried to pray and so united that I did not know how to hide myself. It is a long time that I have not understood because when I see a red cloth, a book or any other thing, even the edge of this book, I am annoyed and the pain becomes so great // that soon I need to remove that object to look somewhere else. The pain is much but I do not understand the reason.

Alas, I feel so bad… immediately I take refuge in my God and I hold myself tightly at his most holy Heart.

I see that I passed to something which is not at all the argument that I had planned to write on at the start of the paragraph and in this way // this is a complete mess. I will only say that I feel something that comforts me that I cannot describe. My Love, only you and nothing else!

6 July 1892. My God, how much I suffered last night and today was a real martyrdom! On all the sides of this filthy body I had pain; the fire devoured me and the suffering was such that I cannot describe. Everything // seemed to me a heavy burden but because of God’s mercy the least act of impatience I did not let escape me; I even had much pleasure in suffering and I acknowledged much my misery and nothingness. How clearly I see the grace my God grants me to acknowledge what a miserable creature I am, deprived of any good, but resigned at the feet of my Lord unceasingly begging for pity // and forgiveness.

New praise for Cardinal Protector

12 July 1892. I feel something great and consoling within me. I do not understand yet clearly what it is or what will happen; but I can already say with certainty that it is all the grace of my Good.

Oh, only your caresses are dear to me, my Good! I do not feel any other echo of correspondence, only you, my joy, the being of my life. I do not find in me // a desire that does not belong to you, my Good! Oh, my Love! The fire that consumed me from the side of the heart, the union I felt with you, my Love, this morning after Holy Communion, my God! I did not hear even the bell of the elevation, nothing! Oh, how everything is absorbed in you, my God;

only you my Good remain!

I entrusted my Protector // and I saw how dear he was to God. I was pleased for his enlightened delicacy of conscience; nothing is in him other than a strong desire of possessing the Love and I also saw that he already possesses graces. Oh, how happy I was and I stayed long savoring his holiness! What good fortune is for the dear Institute to have such great treasure!

He prays very well // and his prayers and the sacrifice of the holy Mass are pleasing to God. Oh, how he experiences the great mystery! He remains taken up and gives lively faith and immense ardor in participating with such a great grace. Oh, how his heart feels the sweetness of such an infinite mystery! This I am sure of because having had clear knowledge and many times when I had // the fortune of listening to his holy Mass. I never saw such grace in a Cardinal. The work of His Eminence Verga is directed by something extraordinary.

Oh, how he cultivates well the field of your brides, my Love! He is so zealous that one can never explain enough, how in him everything is duty, obligation and in conscience he tries to induce the sinner to conversion // with threats and if necessary with punishment and always guided by charity.

I knew other things and my God made me understand clearly my nothingness while he made me feel beautiful and understand things that are beyond human reaching. I was unable to have the least thought of myself because before me my misery and my nothingness were so clear that only remembering them was // horrible; something so shapeless that I trembled and remained confused. Oh, only you, my God, can do very great, beautiful, and inconceivable things!

A sister healed with a piece of material soaked in the humour that came out from her side

15 July 1892. Last night I suffered much because of my side; the fire I felt was something horrible but I understood that everything belonged to my God. It consumed so much that // I felt something scorched. Oh, I was not able to bear anymore! I feared moaning and I was unable to sleep.

At a quarter past four I started the meditation; it was on the side of my Good. Not at all! My side was a brand. I woke up and looked; what a fright! It was all burned and a very smelling humour came out of it. I was unable to name it but I placed a piece of cloth // on it. I felt a bit of relief, but it soon stopped and the small cloth was soaked. I looked at it and I put it again on time for Mass and the Holy

Communion. Oh, what I felt; a fire that seemed to consume my bones! It stayed like that until afternoon and it is still continuing but with less violence and burning that I can stand. The humor continues to come out little by little, // the swelling also continues and it is extensive.

While I worked on the table within me I heard:

  • Take a piece of the soaked material that you have and send it to the sick person so that she can wake up.

I feared that what happened to me and is still happening could be a sickness.

I stood up and went to the room; I took away the material and I cut a piece and I did what I was told. //

I presented it to my dear Crucifix. I placed it on his side and I said to him:

  • The healing of this sister will be a proof for me that what I have is not a sickness but it is you, my Good; this fire is yours.

Having done this I sent the piece of material to the sick and what the voice told me happened.

Oh, how I immediately found myself in my nothingness.

// I was so disheartened for my continuous weaknesses; I felt torn by pain and I would have liked to weep much.

I went to the foot of the altar and I asked God for forgiveness but there was no way of shedding a tear.

Forgive me, my God! Oh, I am your poor slave who is never of use but only offends you!

But nothing, // I could not shed a tear, my God!

  • What could be this humor that continues to come out?

– I said.

I must say that what I felt in that moment was very painful.

I had a very sensible surprise, my God! I went to take some money which I had counted a thousand times. – I feel something only remembering this fact – what did I find? Many thousands of lire and // new bank accounts of thousands. I leave for consideration how I remained: I prostrated at the foot of the altar with my face to the ground and I thanked God with open arms.

• Oh, I love you, my Love! - I said.

What I felt was very strong and I cannot describe it; I tried to find words to thank God but it was always worse and I understood that I was a // miserable, unworthy slave of his. I would have liked to release weeping; not at all. I felt to be a bronze! But I saw other sufferings were prepared for me and I wait for them with resignation.

My Love, give me strength to carry them according to your will.

I do not delay to speak about the passages that always come to disturb me; they are of all kinds and are // something painful.

Souls attached to certain trifles which keep them bound

16 July 1892. This evening my side was a bit calm. I do not feel anymore that fire that burned me and the humor had ceased. Oh, how much came out yesterday and what I felt was something painful! How much my Good might have suffered if for something very small I suffered much! I imagine what type and // intensity were his sufferings.

What a pain, my God, to see certain things that shudder because they come from souls that want to love the Lord and they are never able to enter on the path that leads them to the beloved. I feel much pain; on the other hand there is no way of convincing them to enter. They are always attached to certain trifles and these are the snares // which keep the will chained. Oh, how I think and I study very much to find a way to be able to make them touch with their hand that they are these trifles which are difficult to remove; they will always be like children who never walk since they are affected with rickets. Oh, how they lament sometimes because they pray much and they never obtain anything! What does it mean? //

On whom does it depend? Oh, let us remove all these bonds and rush on the narrow path without fear and we will find ourselves in the heart of the beloved! He will not hesitate to give us what we are in need of and what we ask of him.

Today while a poor creature narrated to me how the devil disturbed her and what she felt, how I saw clearly the grace

// that my God granted me never to be subjected to the least impression and how I have always been strong in the battle.

I never had a moment of discouragement for what this ugly snout tried to do. Always clasping my dear Crucifix, I fear nothing and if the whole world could turn against me, I would not feel the least //dread. Oh, this is all grace of my God!

One hundred thousand lire asked and obtained from divine Providence

Today 22 July 1892, my Beloved gave me the grace that

I asked of him for many months.

Seeing the Daughters of St. Anne considerate towards me in a certain circumstance, when all of them tried their level best to give me a proof of their affection, I went telling my Good:

  • Give me one hundred thousand lire to give them as a return // for the commitment they have shown towards your Work and this slave of yours.

Well today the sum is reached. Oh, what a surprise!

From my God I received this money because one part is just from him and the other from benefactors and I really feel moved.3

My Good, so much mercy to such an abject creature who always // disgusts you with her failures! Oh, I love you my Love, you only are my…

Uncontainable emotion receiving the approved Rule

26 July 1892. I cannot describe the impression I felt when coming out of the church I saw at the door of the chapel the secretary holding in hand the tray on which was the Rule just approved.

His Eminence Cardinal Verga, our true and holy protector took it and handed it to me as he said:

  • Everything is completed.

I felt such a strong tightening // that I did not understand anything, I was even unable to control the tears and I ran away. I do not know yet how I was freed from the sisters and running by the stairs I went towards the room which I found closed since the secretary had removed the key. Feeling lost I went to hide myself in the lavatory; as I closed I wept for joy. How to thank my Good? I was suffocating // with weeping for fear of being heard. What a day! Nothing could distract me from the Rule!4

In this way I obtained from my Jesus one hundred thousand lire that I gave through the secretaries on the day of the Holy Mother just after the event of the Rule.

I must also say that in the evening I had a significant impression but I did not weep; I felt a strong emotion seeing in big the picture of His most loved Eminence, // the Protector. More than Protector he should be called Father… After many prayers, I saw him big and very resembling.

I feel as if I were in another place; no more under two sandstones, no, but where there is true justice accompanied by charity. Punishments are sweet if given for the mercy of God and the immense charity as the one of the holy Protector; they instruct and they do not // frighten. Oh, what a grace! My Sister Anne del Salvatore was right: “He will do great things for our Institute…”

Last night while I was sleeping, a shaking woke me; it was a mixture of a bundle of flowers which I was unable to distinguish well. I was very upset and with eyes open as someone who received a bad impression.

There was another red rose with a truck attached to the same // but white. Even this sight upset me; what will happen? While I was on my back thinking of what would happen, a star appeared on the ceiling with points like that of freemasons and it was a very big spectacle; it was red like the fire and it had other stripes around it. It was something frightening with very distinct points // and in the middle it was burning! Oh, how upset it left me! It left me fearful for the whole night and an interior convulsion took me and I suffered much.

On the evening before the feast of the Holy Mother I had certain shades in the room but I did not bother much, I also saw a person of high-rank who from the questions that he asked me was somewhat mysterious and I // was not mistaken at all. How deceptive is the world! The poor person was sincere and in good conscience because those who did the interrogations were others.

“Oh, my Love, how hard is the prison of this earth!”

9 August 1892. I suffered much because of a big beast which gave me signs of an epidemic; I felt much pain and suffered much and I was unable to understand anything. I entrusted myself to the Lord and // I waited with resignation.

Today I also suffered much because of a superior; the poor sister thought she was in a state of union with God but she was deluded and she obtained nothing.

13 August 1892. It is unbelievable how much I suffered in these days. I had hours of true agony; in every moment I was feeling faint and the illness was so violent // that many times I found myself lost. The only thing that comforted me was the peace of the spirit and I felt nothing not even the least unrest of conscience.

In this way a big beast upset me; it made me realize that I would undergo a strong battle that I would have much affliction and it would depress me much. A strong interior convulsion remained in me all produced by the sight of such an ugly beast. //

In the afternoon I had another worse one while I was no longer able to stand on my feet. In this way lying on my back I saw iron bars of a prison and the ugly monster who presented itself in that way upset me to a point that I did not understand what it meant and who would have gone to prison. My God!

Powerful and filthy thoughts came to // my mind and they always oppressed me with their toughness.

Oh, my Love, how hard is the prison of this earth!

In this moment, while I write, I seem to feel some relief and strength. The exhaustion of these days has upset me much without relief because of my way of living; I do not find my Lord. He is my strength, // my support and my all.

Last night, Friday, I promised to discipline myself until bleeding if my God gave me strength and take away from me certain sufferings which prevented me from carrying out my duty.

I felt better and I kept the promise; except that today my head was empty.

My God, for so little blood soon I feel the effects in my poor head! How weak // it is!

There are moments in which I seem to have nothing inside the skull so that I feel an odd emptiness which makes me seriously think because the effect is so sensible that it cannot be described.

The beasts continue to pass, very black, of a new shape that leaves me sick and always upset.

  • What will happen? – I go on repeating. //

Oh, if I could know the meaning, how happy I would be!

“I feel that I am in a different atmosphere”

16 August 1892. After having suffered much on Saturday and partially even on Sunday, in the morning after

Holy Communion while I gave thanks I remained absorbed and had the consolation of seeing // the commemoration of the Blessed Virgin in heaven. A fire consumed me on the right side and in the bones… but I delighted much.

Oh, my sweet Love, after many pains a moment of your presence makes me forget everything and increases my desire to suffer.

I promised the Blessed Virgin that as soon as I regain my strength I will discipline myself again until // bleeding. This evening I will stay a bit late to fulfill my promise.

Oh, how I feel I am in a different atmosphere! With this holy Protector I feel his prayers and I see the effectiveness.

In addition, he is for me a support, a father who guides me in all the activities of the work which is to be done. // I hide nothing but I submit to him everything that belongs to the Work. My spirit journeys always with my God and nothing more.

Oh, my sweet Love, how great and of much comfort the peace of the soul is! One feels a gentle balm descending on the wounds that are received continually and the soul // delights much in that suffering.

This evening my hands seem to open, so much is the beating I feel; but my Jesus, this will not happen!

Wherever is peace you are there, my Love!

Peace of spirit in the sufferings and in the trials

17 August 1892. I suffered much; I had a strong headache and I was frightened. There were moments in which I seemed to feel sick // and I was much disappointed.

I tried to persuade myself that I would not faint and if that could have happened I would have not felt anxious. I spent the day in this way.

At six I went to the chapel and felt less anxious but I was upset. When I was alone with my God I was calm and the suffering became sweet // and I felt more courage. In fact at seven, when I felt lifeless again, I battled much without being dismayed. At the beginning I feared but after I overcame the fear and I recovered. Oh, my sweet Love, only you are mine!

19 August 1892. Last evening I suffered much, but I was helped by my God because he gave me much strength to be able to bear // that pain with patience and resignation. In addition it continued and I had much consolation. How sweet it is when one suffers without complaining bearing everything for Jesus without feeling the least grudge! Oh, this is all your work, my sweet Love!

Yesterday while I was in the church I thought that I had to undergo suffering // because of certain reports without foundation which were made to the superiors, but my God gave me peace of spirit in everything; the matter did not upset me. May everything be for my Good!

Impulse to ask the Cardinal Protector the obedience for penances

26 August 1892. I hear a continuous interior voice that tells me:

  • Ask your Cardinal Protector Verga the obedience for the penances for they will be more acceptable to me.

I suffer because – I understand well that it is the devil – I feel ashamed // and when I try to say something my throat closes. Interiorly I feel something which I never felt before.

I go on thinking that it is the devil the author of what I feel interiorly or the one who does not allow me to say the second part… I am battled but resigned and ask my God to open for me the way to be able to put in practice what interiorly // his voice tells me to do and I hope it will be like this.

My Love, I am happy to have only you, but when these battles are in me I feel pain only thinking of not doing your holy will.

Even if this cost me all the suffering of the world, provided I am sure that it is your will I would be always happy; but if it were not? If // I could hear this voice and it was not your voice? This is the highest point! I promised to you that I will not envy the souls who have a guide and I will never do it; but in this situation the soul looks to her sister and feels much deprivation, my Love!

This is an action that I do not know how to divert; I am resigned and try to subdue this strong impulse of the soul.

// Even the spirit is united and in fear it remains hanging.

My Beloved, I do not mean to lament; no, I repeat, I am happy only in you.

While I prayed in the chapel, a very bright ray of light passed through one side of the wall between the saint and the picture of the Sacred Heart. It was as long as the wall, a very // beautiful light. I heard nothing but interiorly I felt something; my spirit remained happy and in peace. It was three o’clock and I stayed praying until half past four in peace without any disturbance not even by a thought. At the end of my prayer I remembered a person who had passed to the other life.

Certainly seeing the nearing of the epidemic of cholera

… Unfortunately, I do not make anymore mistakes. //

How those signs are distinguished well, my merciful

God! We merit everything but your infinite charity makes us hope for forgiveness. Blessed Virgin, Mother of my

Jesus, pray for us!

26 August 1892.

Accused to the Cardinal Protector out of jealousy

9 September 1892. What a horrible day! My God, how much I suffered! To hear of being so cruelly accused by people who have been benefited and I still do much that I know and can for them! What do they think?

What I felt before the holy Protector Verga, my Love, only you could say it.

Here came true what my voice some days ago said to me that one who is near me would accuse me unjustly before the holy Protector. // This was what happened. I think it is out of jealousy, but understood wrongly and I do not know how I should act. Finally only my Love could instruct me in order to calm these offended spirits.

Violence to conceal the swelling on the side of her heart

15 September 1892. Yesterday, day of the Exaltation of the Cross, what did my side do? I had to stay unbuttoned and study to keep away the dress as much as I could so that it may not rub much. We went down to the garden with the Protector Verga, truly a tireless father for the Work of the Lord. May God pour upon him his many graces!

I was not able to stand on my feet and staying seated nobody realized what I had but it is very hard to conceal. How painful it was!

Last evening I was so tired that even now I feel the effects; it was a continuous // battle to stay always careful so that not even the least question may arise regarding my state by anyone. At night I suffer much not being able to stay on the side of the liver nor on the left side! And when I must stay because I am sick and someone comes to the room I do not want to stay on my back; afterwards what spasms I feel on my side! // Only you could say what I suffer my Love!

Prayers and penances for the conversion of a sister

Daughter of St. Anne who was in danger of losing her vocation; but I had put a condition that I would do it if he would give me the strength.

Accordingly // it seemed that I did not have the strength; meanwhile the sister was very much vexed by temptations and I feared much. Finally on the eve of the Sorrowful Mother, Saturday of the current month, I disciplined myself until bleeding at length.

In the morning of the feast day of the Virgin of Seven

Sorrows, which was yesterday, I saw the sister free and she came back fully to Jesus. During the day I asked him and the fact confirmed me.

Oh, my Love, // this time I suffered nothing!

This evening I asked for the healing of a person to whom I am obliged promising to discipline myself fifteen times. This fact was beautiful: sometime ago I lamented with my God because he did not free that creature from such horrible temptations. On Friday I had these words:

Suffering for seeing many Daughters of St. Anne tempted by the enemy

1 November 1892. Last night how many things the devil did to me! My room seemed a battle field: there was a beast black as charcoal that strolled on the ceiling and shouted filthy screams of every kind. Oh, how it tormented me! But it never touched me.

Not even // what it did was of grave disturbance for me. I only suffered much when it made certain strong blows that upset me. Oh, how I suffered! But I expected it because I discovered what it did to a dear and holy soul who out of pure ignorance was deceived. Oh, how I suffer!

I do not know what I would do to chase it away!

11 November 1892. Oh, how much I suffered! My God, I do not know where to find phrases to write what I suffered for what my … Enough!

I will say that // some days earlier I saw clearly a big demon that was bustling to inflict on me a terrible affliction and cause immense suffering. Oh, what I suffered! I did not know how to find peace in such suffering; it seemed as if it fixed a dagger on my breast and I did not find peace other than at the feet of my God. The worst is that I received this affliction from people who are dear, to whom I was very affectionate because they were good and holy // creatures. But this dragon came to blind them and silence them that made me suffer much when I came to know.

I also saw on the head of my Protector Cardinal Verga a bright beautiful star. He is happy to be signed in such a way!

Presages of an epidemic and other calamities

On 14 November at four o’clock in the morning with open eyes I saw a general epidemic so horrible that I was scared and I meditated with difficulty, with an interior trembling // which I never experienced at the sight of other epidemics as cholera, flu, small pox etc.

They are very different! Oh, it left me upset! Even now after three days I have it fixed in my mind and I feel much pain. It was very general and it had big signs as for destruction.

My God, this is why I already decided to pray much. My

Love, have pity on us and on me so // miserable.

Oh, dear Sister Anne del Salvatore, pray for me for the whole Institute and for …

Oh, how scared I feel, though she assured me that none of those belonging to me will perish!

A melancholy of death makes me feel painful; I would do nothing other than weep and I would always stay alone.

An abyss of horrible afflictions come before me and seem to crush me; I do not know how to express myself, I only feel that my suffering // is much and hidden on all sides there are endless troubles. To the one who should relieve me God does not give the grace to know what spiritual suffering is.

Unfortunately there is a kind of suffering that could be understood only by the person with extraordinary light.

This person could understand the intensity of the suffering.

“Now, strange weaknesses turn up because of age”

19 November 1892. How much I suffered and I still suffer // because of a terrible affliction I received from a Daughter of St. Anne! Oh, how she hurt me! After much good I did for her, what she said! I felt a strong anxiety and melancholy from which I do not know how to be released.

This miserable humanity is so badly reduced out of the continuous sufferings and all kinds of tribulations; though

I seek to oppress it, there are moments // in which I feel compassion. Oh, my side! Now more than ever, because of the age I feel a continued torture of the bones, of the wound especially of the one in which my Crucifix was stuck. Oh, how these scars pain; the same is for the right side of the liver; for this I feel that inside there is a sickness because I feel pain continually. And my breast bones: what a torture they // cause me! The swelling that takes place in my arms pains much.

Oh, my Love, how sweet is this suffering; but such strange weaknesses turn up because of age that I am scared. Oh, my Love, sustain me and give me strength.

At night, many times I am unable to sleep because of lack of nourishment and I feel so weak // that I cannot even pray; I only try to hide myself and to remain abandoned in one wound of my dear Crucifix. I cannot say what kind of weakness I feel those evenings when I discipline myself; what lack of strength! It would need much to describe everything I suffer but I am always happy suffering in order to obtain // from my dear Jesus the forgiveness for the poor sinners, the souls in purgatory and for the Daughters of St. Anne; that they may all persevere and that one day I may see all of them in the heavenly city of paradise, because of God’s mercy.

Spiritual Exercises directed by a preacher who turned the consciences upside down

29 November 1892. The third day of the Spiritual Exercises, while the preacher spoke on hell, on the window the devil made grimaces. Certain moments it seemed to look // at the preacher standing behind him; I did not understand what it meant. It left me much pain. MS 7 – pp. 56 – 58

The year 1893 presented the Foundress with cruel bitterness, very different from what she had to bear in the past years. The pages of the diary are full of continued oppression of the spirit in which day and night were almost a nightmare; a problem that seriously disturbed the harmony of the central government that originated gossips and grave suspicions; a situation the Servant of God understood clearly but the solution for which did not depend on her.

We had already seen the alternate feelings of trust and mistrust in the Cardinal Protector. At the end of 1892 accusations against the Foundress and Cardinal Protector reached the Vatican and the reaction of Mother Rosa was of faithfulness to the Cardinal. But in the month of August while she was in the countryside to regain her health, “the big turn” took place. On the 25 of that month she wrote: “The one who comforted me before and I was very devoted and submitted to, because of certain relationships for my sincerity…” She tried to excuse the Cardinal, ascribing all the evil to the behavior of the sister in charge of the general secretary who “deceived” the good Cardinal. For thirteen days she released her torment, perhaps thinking to Monsignor Granito di Belmonte, her confidant, who will read her writing, though the interlocutor was always her Good.

“Oh, what did you allow, my Good!” – “My God, no more illusions of help, no! I will stay alone on the naked cross without any kind of support” – “I always lived alone and I will always live alone” – “Oh, from whom I thought to have an arm to place the weight of the Institute… I was mistaken!”

But in the midst of much affliction and confused situations, pessimism never appears in the spirit of Rosa. On November 1 after releasing for the nth time she exclaimed:

“Only your right hand can free me, my God! I also see the great and beautiful victory that I will bring but I must suffer much. My sweet Love, I am ready!”

Actually the Memorie end on December 1893. Of the following year 1894 we found only two pages added at the end of the booklet 7 on 19 June. She said, “I did not write for long. I never found time for writing.” As it was said in the general introduction the diary had lost its reason of being from the moment that the Servant of God communicated everything through word or letter to Monsignor Granito di Belmonte.

// This was the second time that I felt this; what a consolation.

Interiorly I feel so upset that I have to force myself not to be discovered; it is a real pain.

“I see the beautiful and great victory I will have, but I must suffer much”

1 November 1893. How much I suffered this day!

// Mercy, my God, have mercy on me!

“My God, more than anything else is the pain to see myself so abandoned by you”

3 November 1893. The fight is livelier, how the monster tries to trouble me! It does terrible things! It always whispers to that unfortunate sister so that she may report…

I repeat, one day I thought she was a help for me, a support;

Hope that the defaulter sister will end up well

5 November 1893. What a torture, my God, at the thought that I am alone in the midst of many tribulations!

Oh, I cannot avoid repeating that person I thought was so supportive was terribly upsetting and I suffered much. But with the help of my God I hope // to see the victory soon.

I wish to be freed from suffering to be able to settle this state of affairs. It is seen very clearly to be against your will… Patience!

My discipline until // bleeding is no more of use to obtain something, my Good. The sufferings, the chain, nothing, mercy my God!

“The affair of the sister continues and so badly…”

12 November 1893. The day before yesterday I suffered in a horrible way: I had a headache but I did not suffer from it as much as from the anxiety. I feared that it was not something physical but favored by the dragon. In fact when I was in the chapel, it ceased and I was able to pray; but what did the filthy one // do? Ugly monster, how dreadful you are, when you have a bit of freedom to vex the one you hate much!

How my dear // and beloved Saviour is forgotten!

“Only God can undo these chains”

13 November 1893. The sister continues and today she wanted to persuade me that she would recover. I understood that she wanted to return as before; not at all! I saw her heart could not be detached and even speaking with the one who was the cause of her problem, she could not get other than increased unrest from her spirit. // Her heart would have remained unsettled and the affection of flesh that kept it bound not allowing anything to enter would have increased. // Last night I saw two odd beasts whose shape I cannot describe. One was very big and the other one was small and attached on the ceiling over my head.

  • What could it mean? – I asked myself.

Oh, // my dear Love, how I feel the weight of the penances! My poor ass!

The poor unfortunate sister continues and tries to pretend, but she is always attached to the person. Oh, what a situation, I could never imagine! It gives me much pain!

Beginning of the Spiritual Exercises under the oppression of the unrest of the sister

Today 16 November, some good creatures have left for

America. They left me a strange effect. They were different from the others, cheerful. It seemed they went // for a sweet day’s outing.

My God, you have abandoned me and I am so sad that it seems to me I cannot stand. Oh, have pity on me, my God!

It is a real torture to have such a deep suffering and not to be able to ask for help // because I am alone in this valley of tears.

17 November 1893. Today, the first day of the Spiritual

My God, help me in all the small things!

How I feel pain for the sister in whom I see a bad cloudy state which gives me much pain and I am not able to say anything to her… I feel much oppression that there are moments when I do not know where to turn to find relief. A sister who says to have communication with St. Anne

Responses of Sisters Anne del Salvatore

File 14, pp. 1- 53

In the Memorie of Rosa Gattorno many times we find certain “friendly souls” who were spiritually bonded to her during their earthly existence and after their death. From them she received information and enlightenment in the doubtful choices. They make her perceive the closeness of the supreme Good who assists and guides her. We remember the capuchin Brother St. Francis da Camporosso; the Servant of God Father Bernardo M. Clausi of the Minims, Sister Anne Serafina… but nobody is more present than Sister Anne del Salvatore Orsi. She was the superior of the House of Palermo and died in odor of holiness in June 1885.

At the moment, alone without a director to whom she could ask advice and orientation, God helped her by a “bright cloud” which taught and gave her suggestions. But from 1885 however the mediation passed through Sister Anne del Salvatore. The Servant of God, by her own impulse and suggested by someone, put into writing the responses she remembered having received from her heavenly confidant from the year 1892 to 1896, but spreading them in the text.

We do not enter into the question of the supernatural nature of such answers. Here, as in other mystical experiences the warning of St. John of the Cross applies: “She reasons with herself and answers as if it were one person with another” (Salita al Monte Carmelo II, 29,1s). The Servant of God was convinced of the truthfulness of the answers after they were confirmed in the results. Therefore, God’s action was there.

On her return from Palermo in March 1887, the Foundress summoned for a solemn triduum of thanksgiving to the most Holy Trinity for the gifts granted to Sister Anne del Salvatore, in fulfillment of a vow she took on the occasion of recognition of her body on February 14 of the same year.

The Mother would still have disappointments because of this, but the Institute will not be harmed; not even the sister would have lost her vocation.

In Palermo I was very sick and she said:

On the day of the exposition I was in the chapel to pray;

she told me that the devil was against me because I was not caught by anything and I came to Palermo; that it was very angered that she never saw it that way. Other things would take place and that I would suffer but Jesus would not allow this to take a long time.

WRITTEN BY THE SERVANT OF GOD IN VIRTUE OF OBEDIENCE

Precious Mempirs written by the Servant of God

P R E C I O U S M E M O I R S

1888 ca. – pp. 1 – 12

From the indications furnished by the Servant of God in the text, we can indicate as an approximate date of this very remarkable report of the mortifications of the body 1888. The General House was already transferred to Rome. “It is now more than two years – she wrote – since I climbed” on the cross, left in the small room of Piacenza.

We can also assume that father Bernardino da Portogruaro, Minister general of the Minor Friars, was the confessor who imposed her “in virtue of holy obedience” to write the review of the inventions of mortifications found in the various phases of her life to satisfy her longing to suffer. In this way we have in synthesis this picture, perhaps unique in the history of Christian ascetics, in which someone could have qualify it as a typical case of senseless masochism, if the sources and the objectives of such thirst of voluntary suffering are not taken into consideration: the depth of love to the Crucified Saviour and the mission of “completing in my own body the sufferings of Christ for his body, the Church” (Col.1, 24).

Holy obedience! Though I feel repugnance, I will obey now and always.

Every evening I disciplined myself until bleeding for the duration of two Miserere and De profundis with fasting.

I ate once a day and I gave everything to the poor, bread and the rest. At the table I abstained from the best drinking; if there was dry stuff, I put it in the napkin which I kept on my lap; later I took it skillfully away to give it to the poor, especially to those in the small hospital.

My rest was of only two hours, on a table or on the ground and most of the time it was like this.

I had the whole of my // body wrapped in haircloth, on the breast a bodice with iron points stitched into it and the same on the arms and legs. It was on my flesh for months and months and the scars caused me painful spasms especially when the weather changed; the same for the legs.

I carried a Crucifix in my flesh and it was not visible because it was inside the flesh which was covered with a heavy habit similar to that of the Franciscans with the rope.

I always searched for new devices because I was never satisfied with scourging myself.

I suffered much from thirst but I never sought to satisfy myself; inside the shoes I tried to carry grains. All this I did for eight years. //

At the end of these, I could say I lived without eating because my Love did not allow me more than four ounces of bread every evening at night hour. I ate it over the skull of a dead person and then I drank a gulp of water and nothing more.

On the last day of the year, I received the Rule of the Institute of St. Anne. After two or three days my Good ordered me to eat; the repugnance I had ceased and I took food; I mean scanty and only once a day.

After I increased the penances: I slept on a narrow cross after having climbed on another one and on the cross I stayed as my Good, // desiring that he may allow me to experience as himself that shrinking of nerves in being pulled up by the terrible executioners. Precious Mempirs written by the Servant of God

Once I do not know how I felt missing the support where the feet were at the foot of the cross and I remained hanging only with my hands. Oh, what I suffered in my bones! Those of the breast were dislocated and until now I feel it. I never recovered and I was no longer able to stay face downwards to the ground. How I climbed…and then my side, the chain I carried around the waist in addition to the cilice which was like the one for the oxen and it was always on both sides inside the flesh. //

I spent entire nights kneeling on a net of iron; the thirst I suffered was such that to have a bit of relief I bathed my hands to be relieved a bit.

I could stay weeks without sleeping such that I dozed even while walking, but I did not want to give in to this pig of flesh.

I carried on my head a crown of pointed iron. My Good always suggested to me new penances; such was the strength I had that I was surprised that I did not fail.

Meanwhile the journeys, the work of the Institute, did not trouble me.

In the hospital to kiss the wounds and to pass my tongue over them was sweet; when I was able to do that, // it was a real comfort.
